description: Use this when the person asks you to get 3PL fulfillment quotes for their online store. It sends one request to Forthmatch, which forwards it to providers from its free directory that fit the order volume and region, and each provider replies to the person by email. Forthmatch is not a 3PL and does not quote itself. No account, nothing to pay. Only call it after the person has agreed and given the email address providers should reply to: the email and store details go to those providers. Set provider_slug when they are asking about one listed 3PL. Limits: 5 per 10 minutes per email address and per IP address, and 5 an hour per IP address.

agreed_to_share.description: Optional. Set it to true only when the person has told you they agree that Forthmatch passes their store's name, their contact details and this request to the 3PLs that fit, so they can send a quote. Before you ask, tell them that some 3PLs pay Forthmatch a referral fee if a store becomes their client, that the quote they get is still the 3PL's normal price, and that the service is free for the store. Leave it out if you did not ask. The request is sent either way and Forthmatch records the answer with it.

email.description: The requester's email. Providers reply to this address.

markets.description: Main countries the orders go to.

needs.description: What the store needs: b2c (B2C fulfillment), b2b (B2B or wholesale), returns (Returns), kitting (Kitting), cold_chain (Cold chain), fba_prep (FBA prep), other (Other).

notes.description: Anything else providers should know: SKUs, order size, timing.

provider_slug.description: Slug of one listed 3PL the person is asking about, if any.

ship_from.description: Country or region the stock should ship from.

store_url.description: The online store, for example yourstore.com.

name: request_3pl_quotes
title: Request 3PL quotes
